commands.command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=src conda run -n autodrift python -m autodrift.hidden_envelope_multiseed_gate --env-config configs/ppo_m24_human_view_gru_driver.json --checkpoint-policy m62_a250=runs/m62_m37_m61_032_interpolated_checkpoints/checkpoints/alpha_0_25.pt --checkpoint-policy m98_9480=runs/m98_larger_batch_per_target_seed9480/optimized_checkpoint.pt --checkpoint-policy m102_9550=runs/m102_retention_actor_coupling_seed9550/optimized_checkpoint.pt --checkpoint-policy m105_9710=runs/m105_anchor10_outcome_coupling_smoke_seed9710/optimized_checkpoint.pt --probe-seeds 9510,9511,9512 --episodes 30 --horizon-steps 15 --sample-stride 3 --max-samples 800 --ridge 0.1 --device cpu --mean-lift-threshold 0.0 --min-lift-threshold 0.0 --pass-fraction-threshold 1.0 --run-dir runs/m108_baseline_multiseed_hidden_envelope_gate_seed9510
commands.name: m108_baseline_multiseed_hidden_envelope_audit

decision_rule: Compare M98/M102/M105 under the same multi-seed hidden-envelope gate to determine whether M105 damaged hidden belief or whether the probe surface itself is unstable for all current checkpoints.
failure_criteria: M105 is rejected without comparing M98/M102 under the same aggregate gate
a new objective is trained before identifying whether the blocker is model-specific or gate-specific
the audit changes actor inputs or adds hidden parameters to deployable policy inputs
hypothesis: If M98 or M102 passes the M107 aggregate gate while M105 fails, M105's action-anchor outcome update harmed hidden belief. If all fail, the hidden-envelope proof surface or target split needs redesign before more optimization.
success_criteria: M98/M102/M105/M62 are evaluated under the same multi-seed hidden-envelope gate
the result identifies model-specific versus gate-surface failure
next objective or probe redesign is selected from evidence
docs, queue, status, and scoreboard are updated
